contents: 1,852 houses from the 1855 General Board of Health map, including houses where nobody died, with deaths of residents (deaths_r, 661), deaths of non-residents (deaths_nr, 45), total deaths (706), distances in metres to the Broad Street pump, the former pest field and the nearest sewer grate, and projected coordinates.
limits: Coordinates are OSGB 1936 / Airy 1830, not WGS84. Mapping them here would need a datum shift, which this application deliberately does not perform; the distance columns support the analysis without any geometry.
The denominator this file provides is houses, not people. No population per house exists in it, so a rate per house is defensible and a mortality rate per person is not.
The numerator is the 1854 outbreak and the denominator is an 1855 map, so the two do not describe the same moment.

The 45 deaths of non-residents are counted in houses whose residents are the exposed population, so deaths rather than deaths_r mixes a numerator that includes visitors with a denominator of dwellings.
